name: NextPCB
notes: Capabilities page does not split rules by layer count except inner (0.5 oz) vs outer copper. The standard-price thresholds (6/6 mil, holes >= 0.3 mm) come from NextPCB's own blog, not the capabilities page; below them (3.5 mil traces, < 0.3 mm / 0.15-0.2 mm holes) extra cost applies. 0.15 mm drill only for boards <= 1.2 mm thick. Mil values converted at 0.0254 mm/mil.

value_notes.track_width: Standard price: NextPCB blog (custom-pcb-and-pcba-cost): 'Default Values: Typically 6/6mil ... If your design can be adequately supported with 6/6 mil, you can adjust to 6/6mil or larger' to lower cost. Capabilities page minimum is 3/3 mil (1 oz outer).
value_notes.via_drill: Blog pcb-price-difference: 'extremely small holes (less than 0.2mm, where the common standard is >= 0.3mm)'. Capabilities: 0.15-6.5 mm (0.15 only for boards <= 1.2 mm).
value_notes.via_annular_ring: Capabilities 'Via pad size >= 0.1mm' (read as annular ring per side; 'pad hole size will be enlarged 0.125mm in production'). Ambiguous wording.
value_notes.pth_annular_ring: Capabilities 'PTH hole size >= 0.2mm (for single side)' with note 'The annular ring size will be enlarged by 0.2mm in production' - read as PTH annular ring >= 0.2 mm per side. Ambiguous wording; the 'Minimum Annular Ring' table gives 3.5 mil (1 oz) / 4.5 mil (2 oz).
value_notes.hole_to_hole: 'Hole to hole clearance (Different nets) >= 12mil'; same-net via to via >= 8 mil.
value_notes.hole_to_copper: 'Via to track >= 7mil'; 'PTH to track >= 9mil (0.229)'; 'NPTH to track >= 8mil (0.203)'. Value = via figure. Pad-with-hole to pad, different nets >= 0.40 mm.
value_notes.mask_bridge: 'Green: 3.5mil, Black/White: 5mil (0.127), other solder mask: 4mil (0.102)'. Not given per copper weight.
value_notes.smd_pad_to_pad: 'SMD pad to SMD pad clearance (Pad without hole, different nets) >= 0.15mm'; SMD pad to track >= 4 mil.
